pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which noun goes with "mein"? (1 mark)
   A. Vater
   B. Mutter
   C. Tante
   D. Schwester

2. You hear: "Das ist mein Vater. Er heißt Juma. Er ist groß." What is the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Someone talks about the weather
   B. A child describes his or her father
   C. A child describes a sister
   D. Someone orders food

3. What does "Was isst du gern?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where do you eat?
   B. What do you like to eat?
   C. Who eats?
   D. When do you eat?

4. What does "die Milch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. carrot
   C. milk
   D. cocoa

5. Which word is said with the sound "eye"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. Schule
   C. nein
   D. Tier

6. What can you write when you cannot type "ü"? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. ue
   C. ui
   D. uu

7. How is the letter Q named in German? (1 mark)
   A. fow
   B. ee
   C. emm
   D. koo

8. What does "groß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. kind
   B. tall or big
   C. hard-working
   D. old

9. What does "das Badezimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. pot
   C. clock
   D. bathroom

10. Which mark comes before a list or a quotation? (1 mark)
   A. der Doppelpunkt (:)
   B. das Fragezeichen (?)
   C. der Punkt (.)
   D. das Komma (,)

11. Which month comes right after "März"? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. September
   C. Juli
   D. August

12. What does "der Kuchen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. party
   B. candle
   C. present
   D. cake

13. What does "Kamau hat Geburtstag" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau has a birthday
   B. Kamau is ten
   C. Kamau has a cake
   D. Kamau is tired

14. What does "die Tomate" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. breakfast
   B. tomato
   C. banana
   D. fish

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Fisch"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

16. Which food group does "die Kartoffel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Obst

17. What does "Womit sehe ich?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where do I sleep?
   B. Who is that?
   C. What do I see with?
   D. What do I hear with?

18. What does "trocken" mean? (1 mark)
   A. wet
   B. cold
   C. dry
   D. hot

19. What does "über" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. above
   C. next to
   D. behind

20. What does "jung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. funny
   B. young
   C. old
   D. small

21. Which German word or phrase means "brother"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bruder
   B. die Familie
   C. die Schwester
   D. der Freund

22. Which German word or phrase means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschwister
   B. die Eltern
   C. das Kind
   D. die Familie

23. What does "lernen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to drink
   C. to learn or study
   D. to help

24. What does "riechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to help
   B. to smell
   C. to eat
   D. to play

25. Which German word means "to dance"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lesen
   B. tanzen
   C. kochen
   D. duschen

26. What does "der erste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. third
   B. seventh
   C. first
   D. sixth

27. What does "der dritte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. second
   B. first
   C. third
   D. eighth

28. Which German word or phrase means "watermelon"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tomate
   B. das Fleisch
   C. der Apfel
   D. die Wassermelone

29. Which German word or phrase means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. der Regenbogen
   B. der Regen
   C. der Himmel
   D. der Nebel

30. Which German word or phrase means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. der Schnee
   B. die Sonne
   C. der Nebel
   D. der Wind

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)

32. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

33. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)

35. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

36. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

38. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)

40. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)

41. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

43. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

44. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)

45. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

46. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)

48. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Vater
   Vater is a der word, so we say mein Vater.

2. B — A child describes his or her father
   The words Vater, heißt and groß tell us it is about a father.

3. B — What do you like to eat?
   was = what, isst = eat, gern = with pleasure.

4. C — milk
   die Milch means milk.

5. C — nein
   The letters ei sound like the English word eye.

6. B — ue
   ü can be written as ue, ö as oe and ä as ae.

7. D — koo
   In German the letter Q is called koo.

8. B — tall or big
   groß means tall or big.

9. D — bathroom
   das Badezimmer means bathroom.

10. A — der Doppelpunkt (:)
   The colon announces a list or speech.

11. A — April
   After März comes April.

12. D — cake
   der Kuchen means cake.

13. A — Kamau has a birthday
   hat Geburtstag means has a birthday.

14. B — tomato
   die Tomate means tomato.

15. A — der
   It is der Fisch, so the little word is der.

16. C — das Gemüse
   die Kartoffel belongs to das Gemüse.

17. C — What do I see with?
   womit means with what.

18. C — dry
   trocken is dry.

19. B — above
   über means above.

20. B — young
   jung means young.

21. A — der Bruder
   brother in German is der Bruder.

22. B — die Eltern
   parents in German is die Eltern.

23. C — to learn or study
   lernen means to learn or study.

24. B — to smell
   riechen means to smell.

25. B — tanzen
   to dance in German is tanzen.

26. C — first
   der erste means first.

27. C — third
   der dritte means third.

28. D — die Wassermelone
   watermelon in German is die Wassermelone.

29. C — der Himmel
   sky in German is der Himmel.

30. B — die Sonne
   sun in German is die Sonne.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.
